author: Crimson_Aught
body:
Tasty Fight [DTM]
by Crimson Aught

Hello, it is my new old map :D Yes, I've decided to rename (x2) it, because Tasty Fight isn't that old Berry Mix.
It was totally changed, but it is still the same sweet ;-)
Each team has tasty spawn-cake, two enchantment tables, iron souffle supply (1000 blocks, and it is a coincidence :O, I swear),
some extra weapons in chests, two monuments: Donuts and Lollipop.
Edit: Cake Wars is not original name, so now it is Tasty Fight ._.




Details

v1.5.1

Gamemode: Destroy the Monument (DTM)
Monuments: Donuts (Back Left) and Lollipop (Front Right)
Teams: Raspberries(30) vs Blueberries(30)
Size: 225 blocks x 205 blocks

ImagesDownload and YML/XML

I hope, you like it. Or criticism is welcomed :D

Thanks a lot to Prodigy for basis of this html page.

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
Congratulations!

Your Map, Tasty Fight, has been accepted for testing!



Here are some Map Developer Comments:

"Looks really nice. Shape is unique and the style of the map is very unique to me. This should be teated. Much better than the first version" - Edans

"Nice shape of islands, there seems to be quite a lot of variations and it seems like it'll have interesting gameplay." - Fouled

"Much better than last time. Looks really good, an original unique layout and block choice. I would have to see gameplay." - Legoche


Please add me on Skype (Sethskye) if you have Skype so we can go on further details on Testing and to organize dates on when we can test while you are online to watch your map being played!
